assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to demonstrate mastery of vocabulary and expressions in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner uses wide range of vocabulary. Exhibits an excellent sentence structure during oral interactions.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner uses good range of vocabulary. Exhibits correct sentence structures during oral interactions.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner uses a limited range of vocabulary. Exhibits inaccuracies in sentence structures during oral interactions.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner uses few words correctly. Experiences difficulties in word order in a sentence during oral interactions.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to recognize targeted sounds from an audio text in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner is able to recognize targeted sounds in an audio text or oral interactions. Applies the acquired knowledge to other words bearing similar sounds.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner is able to recognize targeted sounds in an audio text or oral interactions.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner attempts to recognize some sounds in an audio text or oral interactions. Needs little guidance.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner misses out on some targeted sounds in an audio text or oral interactions. Attempts to introduce off context details.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to use the target sound in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner is able to use targeted sounds in an audio text or oral interactions. Applies the acquired knowledge to other words bearing similar sounds.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner uses the targeted sounds in an oral interaction very well.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner uses most targeted sounds in an oral interaction.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner attempts to use some few targeted sounds with frequent help.

substrands.name: Exceeds Expectation
learning_outcomes: The learner speaks fluently exhibiting a good intonation with proper pauses. The pace is excellent giving an impressive smoothness due to a proper articulation of words and expressions. Speaks mostly in familiar contexts.
learning_experiences: Approaches Expectation

The learner speaks exhibiting some fair intonation due to an effort made to articulate words and expressions correctly. The pace is moderate giving a fair smoothness. Tries to hold a conversation for shorter period of time.
inquiry_questions: Below Expectation

The learner pronounces words and phrases with difficulties. Speaks with some pauses that affects the smoothness of the conversation. The pace is slow as the learner tries to articulate words correctly.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to infer meaning of words and expressions from a text
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner identifies meanings, clues and details that are not explicitly stated in the text. Makes connections between the text and illustrations.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner identifies all meanings, clues and details that are not explicitly stated in the text.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner identifies some meanings, clues and details that might not be explicitly stated. Works on predictions at times.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner a few meanings, clues and details that are not explicitly stated in the text. Includes inaccurate details or unsubstantiated information.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to demonstrate fluency while reading texts [smoothness, pace, intonation and pauses]
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner reads texts exhibiting a good intonation with proper pauses as per the punctuations, to produce the intended meaning. The pace is excellent giving an impressive
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner reads texts a good intonation with proper pauses as per the punctuations, to produce the intended meaning. The pace is excellent giving an impressive smoothness on
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner reads texts with mid-sentence pauses exhibiting unstable pace due to lack of adherence to punctuations. Intonation is interrupted frequently due to unnecessary
assessment_rubric.below: The learner reads texts word by word followed by long pauses that affects intonation. There is repetition of words or phrases which causes a low pace hence

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to exhibit accuracy for word recognition to convey the intended meaning
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner reads words accurately decoding the syllables which eventually brings out a perfect articulation. Embeds a desired tone to bring out the intended meaning. Further applies phonological knowledge acquire in reading other words in different contexts.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner reads all targeted words with accurate decoding. Articulates words perfectly and embeds a desired tone to bring out the intended meaning.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner reads some of the targeted with accurate decoding. Articulates the syllables to a near perfection. Tries to adopt desired tone for the purpose of bringing out the intended meaning.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner reads a few of the targeted words with correct decoding of the syllables. Tries to adopt a tone that is ambiguous that distorts the intended meaning.
